about_the_game:
Kreya – an open-world fantasy adventure RPG

A mysterious dungeon has opened on the continent of Kreya hiding untold treasures, ancient secrets and deadly dangers. Legends say that powerful artifacts lie in its depths capable of changing the fate of entire kingdoms. Are you ready to be the first to conquer its secrets?

Develop and master crafts

Master various professions: brew potions, create powerful weapons and armor, engage in fishing, manage a household or become a great chef, preparing exotic dishes.

Create your combat style

At your disposal are various schools of magic and a multitude of weapons and equipment. Create a unique combat style.

Join the Adventurers' Guild

Rise to the top of the rankings by completing various quests from finding lost pets to hunting a powerful necromancer.

Complete freedom in character development

Customize your hero to suit your playstyle: equip heavy knight armor, put on the hood of a cold-blooded assassin or wear a wizard's robe. Develop weapon skills, improve magical abilities and combine them into the perfect combat style.

A vast living world full of mysteries

Explore the floors of the mysterious dungeon each hiding a unique story. Fight mythical creatures, solve ancient puzzles and find legendary artifacts that will change your playstyle.

Adventures alone or with friends

Venture into the dungeon alone or team up with friends to face deadly challenges together.

Influence the world of Kreya

Your decisions change the world around you. Build your reputation, grow stronger and shape your destiny!

Are you ready to write your name into the history of Kreya?
